name: Send new competitor pages from sitemaps with Apify to Slack

parameters.content:
## Send new competitor pages from sitemaps with Apify to Slack

### Who's it for
Marketers, SEO and product teams who want to know the day a competitor ships a new landing page, pricing page, integration or blog post.

### How it works
1. Runs every morning at 8:00.
2. Reads your competitors' XML sitemaps with the [Sitemap Extractor & Monitor](https://apify.com/moha-tah/sitemap-extractor) Actor. Sitemaps are discovered automatically from robots.txt.
3. The Actor remembers the last state of each site, so it returns only the **URLs that were added** since the previous run.
4. Groups the new pages by site and posts one Slack message. Nothing is sent when nothing changed.

The first run records a baseline and sends no alert.

### How to set up
1. In **Competitors**, list the websites to watch, one per line.
2. Add your Apify credential to **Check sitemaps (Apify)**.
3. Connect Slack and choose the channel.
4. Run it once to create the baseline, then activate the workflow.

### Requirements
- An [Apify account](https://console.apify.com/sign-up) (the free plan works) and its API token, saved in n8n as a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
- A Slack credential.
- Cost: $0.002 per site check plus $0.001 per new URL (10 competitors daily is about $0.60/month).

### How to customize
Use a different `monitorName` for each watch list. You can also send modified or removed pages by setting `reportModified` or `reportRemoved` in the request body.

### 1. Competitors
One website per line. The monitor name keeps this list's state in your Apify account.

### 2. Check sitemaps with Apify
Only added URLs come back. Add your Apify Header Auth credential here.

### 3. Alert
One Slack message grouped by site; silent when nothing changed.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ startUrls: $json.websites.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), mode: "monitor", monitorName: $json.monitorName, reportModified: false, reportRemoved: false }) }}
